title: centaurea pullata subsp. involucrata
intro: Centaurea pullata subsp. involucrata, commonly known as Knapweed, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, characterized by its purple flowers and hairy leaves. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea pullata subsp. involucrata include soothing digestive issues and reducing fever, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. Its bioactive constituents also exhibit antioxidant properties, which contribute to its overall therapeutic potential.
